text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 9 George Brownlee Court to maintain an existing side and rear yard fence; the fence currently measures approximately 2.26m. The fence does not meet all of the requirements specified in the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption by the property owner of 9 George Brownlee Court, without conditions, thereby allowing the existing side and rear yard fence to be maintained as requested. Directed and require that the rear yard fencing be maintained in good repair. Directed and require that at such time as replacement of the side and rear yard fencing is required, the installations will comply fully with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
